How to connect AI agents to Frontend: Discover the AG-UI Protocol

AI agents do not fit the REST API request and response model. AG-UI is an open event-based protocol that connects the agent to the user interface. The video shows where it is next to MCP and A2A, and the three pillars: state shared with deltas, generative interface and interruptions for human approval.

Published in 2 October 2026 · 8 min 8 s

  • Agentic engineering

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

The problem: the request and answer model

The protocol documentation says: "Agentic applications break the simple request and reply model" 01:03. Before, the client asked, the server returned the data, the screen rendered and the cycle closed 01:03.

REST and GraphQL APIs are deterministic and made for short one-shift transactions 01:23. AI agents run continuously, send responses gradually by streaming and are not deterministic 01:45.

Agents also mix free text, voice and structured tool calls, call subagents in the middle of the way and need to maintain the state by various interactions 02:07. Pure HTTP and loose WebSockets need a new layer, made for this 02:27.

The ecosystem of protocols

The AI protocols are organized in three parts. 02:48:

  • MCP, from Anthropic: connects the agent to tools and databases 02:48.
  • A2A, Google: organizes conversation between agents 02:48.
  • AG-UI: takes care only of the interaction between the agent and the user 03:09.

They do not compete: one complements the other 03:09.

AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based pattern that connects the frontend to any agent backend 03:30. It standardizes how the state, user actions and agent responses circulate, so the teams do not reinvent the connection to each project 03:30.

Shared State

In AG-UI, frontend and agent read and write in the same state at the same time 04:14. The video compares to a Google Docs shared between the machine and the person: the AI understands what you click, and the screen reacts to what the AI decides 04:14.

In order not to overload the network, the protocol sends only the state deltas, in the JSON Patch pattern, with the exact change 04:34. The entire state (state snapshot) only goes at the beginning of the connection or after an error 04:54.

Generative interface

With AG-UI, the model can return real and typed interface components, which the application shows as interactive widgets 05:15. It also accepts specifications such as Google A2UI and MCP-UI 05:15.

Interruptions for human approval

Sometimes the agent has to ask before acting. 05:36. It pauses the flow, the interface warns, and a person reviews, edits or approves the action. Then the execution returns from where it left off, with context intact 05:58.

An open ecosystem

AG-UI already integrates into frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK, Mastra and Pydantic AI 06:21. You don't arrest a supplier 06:41.

Since it's a stream of events, it doesn't get stuck to a site in React. Runs React Native apps, Slack and Microsoft Teams by SDKs ready, and even on the terminal 07:01.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does AG-UI replace MCP?

Nope. MCP connects the agent to the tools; AG-UI connects the agent to the user. They complement each other. 03:09.

Can the officer ask for approval before acting?

Yeah. He pauses, the person reviews or approves, and the execution continues where he left off 05:58.

About the video

Why the traditional API architecture and requests HTTP breaks while trying to connect AI agents to user interfaces? In this 7 minute explanatory video, you will understand how the **AG-UI Protocol** solves the communication bottleneck between autonomous agents and frontend applications.

Learn how AG-UI positions itself in the ecosystem next to **MCP** (Model Context Protocol) and **A2A** (Agent-to-Agent), and discover the three pillars that make the protocol unique: ** Shared State in real time** (via deltas JSON Patch), **Generative UI** and **Human-in-the-Loop (Human-in-the-Loop)**.

💡 **Principais Tópicos Cobertos:**
* ** The REST/GraphQL API Problem**: Agents are asynchronous, long-lasting and non-deterministic, requiring a continuous flow of communication rather than static requests.
* ** The Triad of AI Protocols**:
* ** MCP**: Connects the agent to tools and data sources.
*A2A**: Coordinates communication between different agents.
* **AG-UI**: Connects the agent to the interface and end-user.
* **AG-UI resources**:
* Efficient state synchronization with `STATE DELTA` (JSON Patch RFC 6902).
* Rendering of dynamic visual components (Generative IU).
* Pause and safe recovery for human approval (Interrupts).
* ** Open Ecosystem**: Support for LangChain, CrewAI, Google ADK, Mastra, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI and more.
